builder.objective: V2-02 REPAIR — Fix local persistence. Replace InMemory repositories (entries, persistentTasks, chronoTimer) with AsyncStorage-backed persistent repositories. Add non-tautological persistence test that proves data survives instance recreation. No new feature scope.
builder.scope: Repair only: (1) create AsyncStorage-backed PersistentEntryRepository, PersistentTaskRepository, PersistentChronoTimerRepository; (2) update AppContext.tsx to use persistent repos; (3) replace tautological chrono test with a test that recreates repo instances and verifies data survives; (4) ensure all 183 existing tests still pass.
acceptance: Entries, persistentTasks, and chronoTimer state persist to disk (AsyncStorage or equivalent)
Data survives app restart (proven by non-tautological test: write → recreate instance → read back)
Chrono timer state persists and resumes after restart
All 183 existing tests pass with no regressions

repairFindings.problem: All repositories are InMemory only. No disk persistence. Data lost on restart.
repairFindings.requiredFix: Introduce AsyncStorage-backed repositories for entries, persistentTasks, chronoTimer

repairFindings.problem: Tautological test: reads getChronoState() twice from same in-memory map, never simulates restart
repairFindings.requiredFix: Replace with test that recreates repo instance and verifies chrono state survives
